interaction_phases.interaction: Initiates CHAPS payment — enters beneficiary details, amount (typically £100k+), purpose reference, and selects same-day payment
Reviews CoP result — sees match/partial/no-match confirmation. For no_match: views fraud risk warning and solicitor contact recommendation. Confirms or cancels.
No direct interaction — sanctions screening runs in background. Channel displays 'Verifying payment...' progress indicator.
Reviews full payment summary including irrevocability warning and CHAPS cut-off time. Provides SCA (biometric app approval or SMS OTP). Confirms payment.
No direct interaction during RTGS submission. Channel displays 'Processing CHAPS payment...' with estimated settlement time.
Receives push notification and in-app confirmation of successful CHAPS settlement. Transaction visible in account history with CHAPS label and settlement timestamp.

projections.projection_rule: Beneficiary sort code and account number displayed in full on payment summary (PH-080) and confirmation (PH-082). Required for Consumer Duty evidence.
Full amount in GBP displayed at every interaction phase.
Never surfaced to customer. If blocked: generic message ('We are unable to process this payment'). Tipping-off prohibition applies (POCA 2002 s333A).
projections.masking_rule: Only 'unable to process' message; no sanctions context disclosed

projections.projection_rule: UETR (Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference) displayed in transaction history for customer reference. Enables tracing if solicitor queries.
Displayed prominently when < 30 minutes remain before CHAPS customer cut-off (16:00). Critical for property completions where missing cut-off has legal/financial consequences.

notifications.content: The name on this account doesn't match what you entered. Please check the details with your solicitor before proceeding.
CHAPS payments cannot be recalled once sent. Please check beneficiary details carefully.
Your CHAPS payment of £{amount} to {beneficiary_name} has been sent successfully.
We were unable to complete your CHAPS payment. Reason: {failure_reason}. Your funds have not been debited.

interaction_phases.interaction: Receives MLRO alert when SanctionsHitDetected. Reviews payment details and sanctions match. Takes blocking action or escalates.

projections.projection_rule: Full sanctions match details surfaced to MLRO/operations only via internal portal. Not visible to customer.

notifications.content: Sanctions match detected on CHAPS payment instruction. Payment blocked pending MLRO review.
